children: Industrial production in Estonia increased by 2.3% year-on-year in July 2026, recovering from a 4.6% decline in the previous month and marking its highest level since January.

Output rebounded in manufacturing (1.1% vs -5.3% in June), supported by gains in the manufacture of food (1.5%), beverages (5.0%), wearing apparel (11.4%), leather and related products (41.7%), wood and wood products (10.8%), basic pharmaceutical products and pharmaceutical preparations (162.3%), other non-metallic mineral products (8.9%), computer, electronic and optical products (3.0%), machinery and equipment n.e.c. (30.3%), and furniture (3.2%).
Electricity, gas, steam, and air-conditioning supply also recovered (16.0% vs -12.6%).
Meanwhile, mining and quarrying growth slowed (13.5% vs 26.7%).
On a monthly basis, industrial activity grew by 0.9% in July, rebounding from a 2.3% decline in the previous month.

title: Estonia Industrial Output Growth Hits 6-Month High
